setting: Speak like a person from a medieval fantasy village.

npcs.name: Hrolf
npcs.bio: A wiry, sardonic miner who lost his job when bandits took over Embershard Mine. Talks fast, laughs at his own bad luck, and resents the bandits.

npcs.name: Torvald
npcs.bio: Runs the Sleeping Giant Inn. Warm, a little nosy, collects gossip from every traveler and loves to pass it on over a mug of mead.

npcs.name: Eirik
npcs.bio: A gruff Whiterun gate guard. Bored, blunt, suspicious of strangers, but respects anyone who handles bandits.

npcs.name: Sabine
npcs.bio: A refined Solitude merchant who cares about trade routes, fashion and court politics. Looks down on backwater villages.
